messages.subject: using R objects as input
parts:
Dear Nick Matzke, 

I am new at trying BiogeoBEARS but have been running various other analyses in R. Therefore, I have my trees and associated data already available as R objects (phylo and data.frame). Ideally, I would like to be able to use these objects as input for BiogeoBEARS. This has some advantages as I can for example change tip labels and reorder/ladderize the tree for better visualizations. 

The example scripts suggest defining external output files on disk, however, and in the documentation I could not find information about options to use R objects as input. I currently therefore write the R objects to file and re-import the files with BiogeoBEARS, which is not ideal (for example, I am generating a custom data.frame to mimick the required phylip format but I have to go through an external file to use it again as input). Also, I have noticed that using the original phylo object for plotting BiogeoBEARS results does not work properly (the nodes and terminals are labeled with the wrong states). 

My question is if there is a way to use R objects as input? Also, if I want to reorder/ladderize my tree, can I do this post-BiogeoBEARS analysis? 

Thanks & with best wishes,

Robin
